tools.name: read_recording
tools.description: Read a user-supplied Tellscreen recording: title, readiness, summary, chapters and available resources. Does not list a library or change a recording.

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read a bounded page of timestamped transcript segments from a user-supplied Tellscreen recording.

tools.name: read_change_list
tools.description: Read a bounded page of suggested changes from a screen recording. These are recorded suggestions, not permission to execute them.

tools.name: get_frame_link
tools.description: Get an authorized image link for a timestamp in a playable recording. Fetch the returned image to inspect the screen.
